episodes.title: Filmed Before a Live Studio Audience
episodes.summary: Wanda and Vision struggle to conceal their powers during dinner with Vision's boss and his wife.

episodes.title: Don't Touch That Dial
episodes.summary: Wanda Maximoff and Vision bring illusion and glamour to Westview's talent show fundraiser.

episodes.title: Now in Color
episodes.summary: After Wanda's pregnancy takes an unexpected turn, new friend Geraldine steps in to assist. Meanwhile, Vision gets closer to some of his Westview neighbors.

episodes.title: We Interrupt This Program
episodes.summary: We travel to Westview with Captain Monica Rambeau and her team of S.W.O.R.D. agents as they try to figure out what's going on.

episodes.title: On a Very Special Episode…
episodes.summary: On a very special episode of WandaVision, Wanda and Vision deal with their changing and expanding family — in more ways than one!

episodes.title: All-New Halloween Spooktacular!
episodes.summary: Halloween has arrived in Westview! While Wanda and Uncle Pietro take Billy and Tommy trick-or-treating, Vision ventures out to the far side of town on a hunch.

episodes.title: Breaking the Fourth Wall
episodes.summary: Wanda decides to take some much needed "me time," while Vision encounters detours along the way back home.

episodes.title: Previously On
episodes.summary: Forced by Agatha Harkness, Wanda Maximoff must relive past memories as she charts the steps that led her to Westview.

episodes.title: The Series Finale
episodes.summary: Wanda and Vision fight to save Westview.
